description: Docker daemon.json security audit — Offline security audit of Docker's /etc/docker/daemon.json (CIS Docker Benchmark section 2): Docker API exposed on tcp:// without TLS or with TLS but no client-certificate verification (root on the host), missing tlscacert/tlscert/tlskey, icc, userns-remap, no-new-privileges, unconfined seccomp, insecure registries and HTTP mirrors, iptables/ip6tables off, default bind ip, live-restore, userland-proxy, log driver and log rotation, debug/experimental, deprecated keys (graph, cluster-store). Returns PASS / REVIEW / FIX BEFORE DEPLOY / BLOCK, score, grade, API exposure, findings with fixes and a hardened daemon.json. Params: text= (the JSON) or url=. Price: $0.006 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: security_docker_daemon_check
